mapper.select: select c.status from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case c join cms_registration r on ((r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = c.activity_id) or (r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = c.topic_id)) and (r.parent_order_no = c.parent_order_no or (c.case_type = 'PARTIAL_CHAPTERS' and c.payer_registration_id = r.id)) and r.member_id = c.payer_member_id where r.id = #{registrationId} and r.member_id = #{memberId} and (json_contains(c.verified_registration_ids_json, cast(r.id as char)) or json_contains(c.unverified_registration_ids_json, cast(r.id as char)))
mapper.sql: id, club_id, activity_id, topic_id, owner_member_id, actor_member_id, parent_order_no, payer_registration_id, payer_member_id, paid_cash_amount_fen, verified_registration_ids_json, unverified_registration_ids_json, case_type, chapter_snapshot_json, status, assessed_refund_amount_fen, assessment_note, assessed_by_user_id, assessment_request_id, assessed_at, actual_refund_amount_fen, manual_channel, evidence_object_key, lower(hex(evidence_sha256)) as evidence_sha256_hex, handle_note, handled_by_user_id, handle_request_id, handled_at, verification_note, verified_by_user_id, verify_request_id, verified_at, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into activity_cancel_manual_refund_case (club_id, activity_id, topic_id, owner_member_id, actor_member_id, parent_order_no, payer_registration_id, payer_member_id, paid_cash_amount_fen, verified_registration_ids_json, unverified_registration_ids_json, case_type, chapter_snapshot_json, status, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{clubId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{parentOrderNo}, #{payerRegistrationId}, #{payerMemberId}, #{paidCashAmountFen}, #{verifiedRegistrationIdsJson}, #{unverifiedRegistrationIdsJson}, #{caseType}, #{chapterSnapshotJson}, 'PENDING_ASSESSMENT', 0, now(3), now(3))
mapper.select: select from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case where id = #{caseId} for update
select from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case where activity_id = #{activityId} and parent_order_no = #{parentOrderNo} for update
select from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case where topic_id = #{topicId} and parent_order_no = #{parentOrderNo} for update
select from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case where assessment_request_id = #{requestId} for update
select from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case where handle_request_id = #{requestId} for update
select from activity_cancel_manual_refund_case where verify_request_id = #{requestId} for update
mapper.update: update activity_cancel_manual_refund_case set status = #{decision}, assessed_refund_amount_fen = #{amountFen}, assessment_note = #{note}, assessed_by_user_id = #{assessorUserId}, assessment_request_id = #{requestId}, assessed_at = #{assessedAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{assessedAt} where id = #{caseId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'PENDING_ASSESSMENT' and assessment_request_id is null

update activity_cancel_manual_refund_case set status = 'MANUAL_REFUND_RECORDED', actual_refund_amount_fen = #{actualAmountFen}, manual_channel = #{channel}, evidence_object_key = #{evidenceObjectKey}, evidence_sha256 = unhex(#{evidenceSha256}), handle_note = #{note}, handled_by_user_id = #{handlerUserId}, handle_request_id = #{requestId}, handled_at = #{handledAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{handledAt} where id = #{caseId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'MANUAL_REFUND_REQUIRED' and handle_request_id is null and #{actualAmountFen} = assessed_refund_amount_fen

update activity_cancel_manual_refund_case set status = 'MANUAL_REFUND_EVIDENCE_VERIFIED', verification_note = #{note}, verified_by_user_id = #{verifierUserId}, verify_request_id = #{requestId}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{verifiedAt} where id = #{caseId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'MANUAL_REFUND_RECORDED' and verify_request_id is null and handled_by_user_id <> #{verifierUserId} and evidence_sha256 = unhex(#{evidenceSha256})

update activity_cancel_manual_refund_case set status = 'MANUAL_REFUND_REQUIRED', actual_refund_amount_fen = null, manual_channel = null, evidence_object_key = null, evidence_sha256 = null, handle_note = null, handled_by_user_id = null, handle_request_id = null, handled_at = null, version = version + 1, update_time = #{reworkedAt} where id = #{caseId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'MANUAL_REFUND_RECORDED' and verify_request_id is null

update activity_cancel_manual_refund_case set status = 'PENDING_ASSESSMENT', assessed_refund_amount_fen = null, assessment_note = null, assessed_by_user_id = null, assessment_request_id = null, assessed_at = null, version = version + 1, update_time = #{reopenedAt} where id = #{caseId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'NO_REFUND' and actual_refund_amount_fen is null and handled_by_user_id is null and verified_by_user_id is null
